citations.F1: N+1 user SELECT queries in serialize_event — each event fetches user separately; batch fetch all users in one query before serialization
citations.F2: O(N) deduplication — seen: list has O(N) membership test; use set for O(1)
citations.F3: Blocking requests.get() in serialize_event — lookup_geo blocks event loop causing /healthz timeout and pod restarts; convert lookup_geo to async with httpx
citations.F4: Missing composite index on (org_id, created_at) — causes 1.2-1.6s query for large orgs; create with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY
citations.F5: Unbounded _request_timings list — never trimmed, grows forever; cap with collections.deque(maxlen=10000)
citations.F6: Unbounded _geo_cache dict — no eviction or TTL; implement with functools.lru_cache
